Performing two sajdah after taravih and reading “سبوح، قدوس، رب الملائكة والروح” ten times with Ayatul Kursi 4201 views Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. Fasting and Offering Nafl on 27 Rajab 10623 views Q. Our Imam in the Masjid is having no beard 3761 views Q. I have question related to salah 2046 views Q. Our local masjid does not have an Imam. However sometimes the Imam does not follow Sunnah and is clean shaven, or his pants drag to the floor, whereas the people behind him in the saafa are following the sunnah tradition, yet they do not stand up for Imamaat. How does one stop this from happening without causing rifts? 3188 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160442 Country: India Title: Sunnat Namaz Question: Please guide me in light of Quran & Hadith. Is it OK, if I leave/not offer all Sunnat Namaz regularly in Zuhr, Asr & Maghrib because of any work commitment (Job etc.)? Is it mandatory to offer all Sunnat Namaz of Jumuah, Zuhr? Answer ID: 160442 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 870/697/SN=8/1439) Four rakah before and two rakah after Zuhr, two rakah after Maghrib and 4-4 rakah before and after Jumuah are sunnah muwakkidah. It is not right to develop the habit of missing them due to job. وفى فتاوى الفضيلي: وإذا استاجر رجلاً يوماً يعمل كذا فعليه أن يعمل العمل إلى تمام المدة ولا يشتغل بشيئ آخر سوى المكتوبة وفى فتاوى سمرقند وقد قال بعض مشائخنا : له أن يؤدي السنة ايضاً واتفقوا أنه لا يؤدى نفلاً وعليه الفتوى (در مختار مع الشامى 9/ 96، ط: زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
